$comment: The platforms of the release: one row per platform that the Python wheel and the npm packages of the TypeScript client are built for.

Readers: the metadata job of release.yml (the wheel matrix: the rows whose release is publish) and clients/typescript/tests/packages/platforms.ts (the npm matrix of typescript-packages.yml: every row).
name         the job name and the artifact name of the row
release      publish: the release builds, checks and publishes the wheel and the npm platform package of this row, and the horsies npm package lists the platform package as an optional dependency.
hold: typescript-packages.yml builds and checks the npm platform package; no wheel is built; nothing is published; horsies does not list the platform package.
runner       a GitHub runner of the row's own CPU: the builds and the load checks run natively
wheel        the wheel fields of release.yml: manylinux (Linux only), platform_tag, import_image (Linux only), web_ui_check
npm          platform: the napi platform name, the suffix of the platform package @horsies/native-<platform>; cpu: the npm cpu value
build: glibc-2.17-toolchain (napi build --use-napi-cross on the runner), alpine-container (napi build in a node:<version>-<node_variant> container), runner (napi build on the runner)

install: container (the install checks run in node:<version>-<node_variant> and oven/bun:<version>-<bun_variant>; the versions are in typescript-packages.yml), runner (the install checks run on the runner)
